pages.title: All Swords Pay Homage
pages.text: Swords descend in six streams, pursue the caster's crosshair, pass through their mark, and turn for another attack.$(br2)$(bold)Type:$() Extra Skill$(br)$(bold)Source:$() Decipher an Ancient Book and study a Myriad Swords Return Manual

pages.title: Maintaining the Art
pages.text: Hold the skill key to cast and release it to stop. Maintaining the art consumes $(bold)2,000 magicules per second$(); it cannot continue without enough energy. The formation contains 60 swords divided into six circulating streams.

pages.title: Targeting and Damage
pages.text: The crosshair can lock an unobstructed valid creature up to about 48 blocks away. Attacks begin after roughly 0.9 seconds of steady aim, then deal $(bold)8 damage$() about once every 2 ticks. Successive strikes clear normal hurt invulnerability, producing a dense chain of hits.
